name: literature-in-the-loop
description: Literature-in-the-Loop: the Raman analysis skill for 2D and layered materials (artifact checks, peak fitting, identification, mode assignment, polarization, cited relations for layer number, strain, doping and defects, delivered as a Marimo notebook) and the meta skill that builds such skills for other measurement techniques.

author.name: Aditya Kumar, Pratyush Kumar Das, Sourish Dey
